ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Venus and Neptune

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on your image and your personal energy. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on rest and your inner life. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on your career and your goals. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on relationships and partnerships. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on home and family. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Venus and Neptune are together in {S:0}: affection and harmony, inspiration and sensitivity, all focused on your money and what you value. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.
